source.check: the only nominee (News-Letter and Irish News, 7 January 1930)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Monday 6 January, poll Wednesday 15 January 1930. Ten Unionists and one Labour member were returned unopposed; Dock, Falls, Shankill and Smithfield were contested (Belfast News-Letter and Irish News, 7 January; News-Letter, 16 January 1930). Returned unopposed.
